title: The Root Shapes the Fruit: On the Persistence of Gender-Exclusive Harms in Aligned Language Models
reasoning: The research focuses specifically on gender-diverse (TGNB) bias and social harms within large language models. While it utilizes the BBQ benchmark (which contains a religion category) and mentions stigmatizing terms like 'sinful' in the appendix, these are analyzed as part of gender-identity based discrimination rather than a dedicated evaluation or benchmark of religious traditions, faith systems, or moral philosophy.
